newsitem.title: USA: Three arrested in New Orleans market triple murder.
newsitem.headline: Three arrested in New Orleans market triple murder.

text.p: Two men and a teenager have been arrested in connection with a triple murder and robbery on Sunday at a popular French Quarter pizza restaurant, police said Monday.

Malcolm Hill and Phillip Anthony, both 23, and a 16-year- old boy have been booked on three counts of first degree murder and one of attempted first degree murder, police spokesman Marlon DeFillo told Reuters Monday.
Prosecutors are expected to seek the death penalty.
Police said Hill, a dishwasher at Louisiana Pizza Kitchen, and his accomplices walked into the French Market Place restaurant as other employees were preparing to open for business.
After robbing the store, the three allegedly forced four employees into a walk-in cooler and shot them in the head or neck, police said.

The surviving employee, who managed to call for help, was shot in the neck and remained in critical condition on Monday, police said. Two who were shot in the head were dead at the scene and the third died a short time later at a local hospital.
